description: Returns the public holidays of Georgia: every holiday of one year, or the next holidays on or after a date. Each holiday gives its date (YYYY-MM-DD), its weekday, and its name in Georgian or English. With no input, it returns every holiday of the current year in Georgia. It supports the years from 2025 to the next year. The list holds no one-off day off that the government declares by decree. Data from Nager.Date.

from.description: A date, YYYY-MM-DD. The tool returns the next holidays on or after it, up to limit.

language.description: The language of the holiday names: ka or en. The default is en.

limit.description: The maximum count of holidays with from, 1 to 20. The default is 1. A year returns every holiday.

year.description: The year, from 2025 to the next year. The default is the current year. Give a year or from, not both.

name: holidays_list_holidays

as_of.description: The instant at which the server read the holidays, RFC 3339.

holidays.description: The public holidays, in date order.

date.description: The date of the holiday, YYYY-MM-DD.

weekday.description: The day of the week: monday to sunday.

source.description: The source of the data: Nager.Date.

stale.description: True when Nager.Date did not answer and the server returns holidays it read before.

title: List the public holidays of Georgia
